takeaways.text: Lines up **Slot** on **53%** of 205 plays (n=109); also Inline (tight) 29% (n=60).
Route on **94%** / blocks on **6%** of dropbacks (95% CI 90–96%, n=205) — 7 pts above the TE average of 86%.
From **SINGLEBACK** (formation), route rate is **79%** (CI 60–90%, n=28) — less likely to run a route than his overall 94%.

Because he releases into a route on ~94% of dropbacks and most often from Slot, a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.

farthest from his median depth — an outlier, NOT representative
